memory_update.text: AXTI should be carried forward as the main underfollowed public-market candidate for the InP substrate layer; key gating checks are InP revenue mix, export controls, capacity expansion, and customer qualification evidence.
ALMU should remain in the speculative-shadow lane until named commercial AI/datacom customers, qualification status, revenue scale, and dilution risk are verified.
COHR and LITE are not underfollowed but are essential reference anchors for InP laser/device capacity, pricing tightness, and the pace of AI optical interconnect demand.
Need a later pass on non-U.S. substrate and photonics suppliers, plus test/measurement vendors for 800G/1.6T optical qualification, because this pass was constrained to U.S.-listed companies.

node: Photonic components: InP lasers, photodetectors, precision substrates, and compound-semiconductor platforms
summary: Expanded the AI photonic-components node into a two-lane universe. Reference names are Coherent and Lumentum because they are direct InP laser/device capacity anchors for AI optical interconnects. The underfollowed discovery lane is stronger in AXT, a merchant InP/GaAs/Ge substrate supplier with explicit AI optical-transmission exposure and few primary InP substrate suppliers. Aeluma remains a speculative-shadow candidate: it is attempting III-V photonics scaling on larger silicon wafers and has contracts/partners tied to high-speed datacom, but commercial AI qualification and customer evidence remain the key gating items.
